Package org.rapidcow.trivnote.libexpr

Interface Datum

All Known Subinterfaces:
Atom
All Known Implementing Classes:
Cons, ConsCell, ConsList, Nil, NumberScalar, Scalar, StringScalar, Symbol, TruthScalar
public sealed interface Datum permits Atom, Cons, Nil
Basic unit of an S-expression. A datum is either an Atom, a Cons, or Nil.

Note that Nil is both an atom (to be distinguished from the Atom class, which is exclusively atoms with a value) and a list.

Datum promises no interface methods explicitly, though through being a sealed interface it limits the classes that can implement it. For that reason we can guarantee that all datums implement hashCode() and equals(Object) in a way such that they are compared by value, not by object identity.

  • Method Details

    • isAtom

      static boolean isAtom(Datum node)
      Returns whether the datum is an atom. This method checks for more than Atom class: namely, nil is an atom devoid of value.
      Parameters:
      node - the datum
      Returns:
      whether the datum is an atom

    • isList

      static boolean isList(Datum node)
      Returns whether the datum is a list. A list is either a cons cell or nil. A non-nil atom is not considered a list, despite DatumList treating it as an empty list with itself as the improper terminator.

      This is a basic type check and does not check that the terminator is nil. To validate a proper list, use isProperList(Datum) or asList(Datum) if you need to access its elements.

      Parameters:
      node - the datum
      Returns:
      whether the datum is a list

    • isProperList

      static boolean isProperList(Datum node)
      Returns whether datum is a proper list. This is a stronger version of isList(Datum) that requires a nil terminator.
      Parameters:
      node - the datum
      Returns:
      whether datum is a proper list
      Since:
      0.1.0

    • asList

      static DatumList asList(Datum node)
      Returns the datum as a list. The returned view conforms to the interface List<Datum,Datum>.

      Note this view is even more permissive than isAtom(org.rapidcow.trivnote.libexpr.Datum), treating non-nil atoms as empty lists with itself as the improper terminator. If this seems unacceptable, chain this call with .requireProperTail() or use asProperList(Datum).

      Parameters:
      node - the datum
      Returns:
      a view as a list
      Since:
      0.1.0

    • asAlist

      static AssocList asAlist(Datum node)
      Returns the datum as an associative list. The returned view conforms to the interface Map<Datum,Datum>. On top of being a proper list with a nil-terminator, each element must be a cons whose car is the key and whose cdr is the value. First car-key wins.
      Parameters:
      node - datum
      Returns:
      the datum as an associative list
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the list is not a proper list, or the list consists of any non-cons datum
      NullPointerException - if node is null
      Since:
      0.1.0

    • fromMap

      static AssocList fromMap(Map<? extends Datum,? extends Datum> map)
      Copies a map wrapped in an associative map view. Entries become cons pairs in the iteration order of the source map’s entry set. Chain this call with .head() if you just need the datum for serialization.
      Parameters:
      map - the source map
      Returns:
      a copy of the map wrapped in an associative map datum view
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if the map, any key, or any value is null
      Since:
      0.1.0
